full_judgment: 2. Judgment-debtors-petitioners in Leave Petition No. 960 of 2000 are opposing the Execution Case No. 2 of 1996 which has been filed for execution of the decree dated 18th August. 1960 (decree signed on 25th August 1960) in Title Suit No. 206 of 1951 of the 2nd Court of Munsif (Now Assistant Judge) which was for declaration of title and khas possession in respect of 29 bighas, or in other words 7 acres of land, contending inter alia, that decree holders 1.5.8.9.10.11.12 and 14 are not residing in Bangladesh and that they have not authorized the decree-holder respondents to represent them in the execution case, that the land is unspecified. that decree-holders have filed Execution Case as regard land which is excess of the decretal land, that 10/15 persons arc residing in the land taking settlement front Government in 1987, that under Section 6 of the Land Reforms Ordinance No. 10 of 1984 settlement holders cannot evicted and that execution is barred by limitation.
